The '''Ebruchi command ship''', also known as the '''Ebruchi command vessel''', was a type of [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] used by the [[Ebruchi]] Pirates. It served as the backbone of the Ebruchi fleets. The vessels were utilized as [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] for Ebruchi flotillas and scout squadrons. They were also utilized as [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ships]] for the rest of an Ebruchi clan's fleet.
